subject: t6
summary: REVIEW FAILED for task T6 (four commits: 'add the implementer agent', 'move the rules that only the committer held into commit-changes', 'move the rules that only the planner held into create-issue', 'record the rules of the implementer, committer and planner profiles'; the cherry-picked PR 3049 audit commit was ignored). The agent file is accurate (model inherit, no Agent tool, commit-changes and write-unit-test preloaded, reply name and verdicts match D18 and the schema), the three committer rules and the planner rules are in the skills the inventory names, linter all and the validators pass, and the commit series follows the Commit Points. Two problems block: (1) the inventory sends the implementer's workflow steps to the agent file, which the specification forbids ('workflow text never goes there', AC6, P2) and which makes a Claude-only adapter the only home of the workflow (AGENTS.md policy 7); the task recorded this as its own decision, so the maintainer must choose between a skill that owns the implementation sequence and an amendment of P2/AC6; (2) rule 1 of the new 'Checks Before The Commit' asks the committing agent to make sure every completed acceptance criterion is ticked and to update the specification first, which the implementer, who commits before the task review and must never tick a criterion, cannot satisfy. Smaller findings: a section name the inventory cites does not exist, a few profile rules have no row, the specification's branch field is stale, and two skills' links still name only the old profile. No checkbox was ticked.

findings.location: docs/issues/open/2904-2003-migrate-custom-agents-to-claude-code/removed-profile-rules.md, section `implementer` (rows 'Step 1' to 'Step 5' with destination 'Agent file, "Workflow" step N'); .claude/agents/implementer.md, section Workflow
findings.description: The Implementation Plan of ISSUE.md says the inventory destination 'is the agent file only for a rule about the role itself (its identity, tools, inputs or report format), which P2 keeps in the agent; workflow text never goes there', and AC6 allows the agent file only for identity, tools, inputs and report format. T6 puts the seven-step implementation workflow (analyse, decompose, TDD, policies, verify, completion review, commit) in the agent file and records that as a 'Decision of the task' in the progress log, without a maintainer decision. It also leaves a provider-specific adapter as the only home of a repository workflow, which AGENTS.md policy 7 and the governance ADR rule out (D9 allowed a self-contained body only for the orchestrator). Remediation, after the maintainer chooses (see questions): either move the sequence into a repository skill (for example a new `implement-task` skill created with `add-new-skill`), preload it from the agent and point the inventory rows at it, or amend P2, AC6 and the Implementation Plan paragraph with the maintainer's dated decision.

The item says to 'check that every completed acceptance criterion is ticked' and 'When the specification is out of date, update it first'. In the flow of D3 and D14 the implementer commits before the task reviewer runs, and its agent file says 'you never tick a criterion of the specification yourself' (review-task step 5 reserves that to the reviewer). A preloaded rule that the agent cannot follow without breaking another invites it to tick criteria itself or to stall. T6's own commits were made with AC boxes unticked, which item 1 as written would reject. Remediation: reword item 1 so the committer checks that the progress log, the task table and the evidence are current and that only criteria a reviewer verified are ticked (no box ticked by the author), keeping the manual-evidence sentence for a completion commit; adjust the inventory row 'Workflow 1' accordingly.

findings.location: docs/issues/open/2904-2003-migrate-custom-agents-to-claude-code/removed-profile-rules.md, rows 'Step 5: compare the result ...' (implementer) and 'Require an evidence-based completion review ...' (planner)
findings.description: Both rows cite skill `create-issue`, "Implementation Completion Review". `create-issue` has no section with that name (its headings were listed); the rule is in 'Verification Requirements for Issue Specs' item 5 and in the Step 1 list of sections to initialize. 'Implementation Completion Review' is a section of the issue template. Remediation: cite `create-issue`, 'Verification Requirements for Issue Specs' item 5 (and `docs/templates/ISSUE.md` if wanted).

Some rules of the profiles have no row. implementer.agent.md Step 5 item 5 (no retrospective for routine work; retrospectives are evidence-based and blameless and not a substitute for criteria verification or a diary) and the legacy-migration prerequisite of item 2: they are held by docs/templates/IMPLEMENTATION-RETROSPECTIVE.md, review-task step 7 and create-issue 'Migrating Legacy Specifications'. planner.agent.md 'Ensure plans are aligned with repository quality standards and workflow expectations' (Repository Rules, third bullet). Remediation: add one row each with the destination that already holds it (or 'Dropped' with the reason).

The uncommitted update sets last-updated-utc and the T6 row but leaves `branch: "2904-t5-task-reviewer"`, while the work is on `2904-t6-implementer` (the T2 review raised the same point for T2's branch). The reviewer may only tick checkboxes in this file, so it was not changed. Remediation: set `branch` to the T6 branch name.

findings.location: .claude/skills/fix-bug/SKILL.md ('Skill Links', frontmatter related-artifacts); .claude/skills/add-rust-dependency/SKILL.md ('Skill Links', frontmatter related-artifacts)
findings.description: Both skills list `.github/agents/implementer.agent.md` as the artifact to review when they change, because that profile invoked them (it also carried the marker `skill-link: add-rust-dependency`). The new `.claude/agents/implementer.md` now invokes both (Workflow steps 1 and 4) and is not listed, so a change to either skill gives no pointer to the agent (AGENTS.md essential rule 7). Remediation: add `.claude/agents/implementer.md` next to the old path in both skills now; T10 removes the old path.

findings.location: docs/issues/open/2904-2003-migrate-custom-agents-to-claude-code/removed-profile-rules.md, section `committer`, row 'Do not bypass failing checks without telling the user what failed.'
findings.description: The cited sections ('Automated Checks', 'GPG Timeout Handling') require the script to exit 0 and forbid bypassing signing, but only the GPG section says to tell the user what failed. Remediation: say in Notes that the rule is covered by the exit-0 requirement and the GPG notification, or mark the 'tell the user' part as dropped because the implementer reports failures in its reply.
